title: Model Opportunity Concentration Index (MOCI) pilot & competitive trigger scaffold
creator: Priya Nambiar
description:
Objective: Design and pilot a compact metric — the Model Opportunity Concentration Index (MOCI) — that quantifies how concentrated opportunity (demand + sensitivity to latency/cost) is across available model variants for a given enterprise vertical. The index will help PM and sourcing to prioritize model onboarding, reserve-capacity commitments, and fallback policies.

Scope: (1) Define MOCI formula combining signal inputs (usage share by workload archetype, latency sensitivity, cost delta to fallback, license/availability risk). (2) Run MOCI on historical telemetry for Q4 2024 synthetic workloads + two customer cohorts (search and RAG). (3) Build a one-page dashboard prototype in the Console to surface top-10 high-concentration model segments and suggested actions. (4) Deliver a short playbook: thresholds for reserve vs hosted spend, and alert triggers for model supply disruption.

Deliverables: metric spec doc, dataset and reproduction notebook, dashboard mock + prototype, 2-page playbook with trigger thresholds and example routing rules.
acceptance_criteria: MOCI spec published in Confluence with formula, input weighting rationale, and sample calculations
Repro notebook that can re-run MOCI over stored telemetry (token counts, per-route latency SLA violations, model availability incidents) with README
Prototype dashboard in Console staging that displays MOCI for at least 3 verticals and top-10 model-variant rows
Playbook with recommended thresholds and mapping of MOCI bands to actions (e.g., recommend reserved capacity, immediate procurement, or fallback hardening) signed off by Head of Product
Runbook created for alerts: MOCI delta > 0.15 over 7-day rolling triggers an incident review and vendor outreach
